# ISOFRAC PeakFinder Module
## Purpose
This module finds distinct protein isoform signals (peaks) inside clusters of peptides produced by the HDBSCAN clustering step.
Main goals:
	-	Detect peaks inside each peptide cluster (these peaks represent protein isoform candidates).
	-	Estimate peak position and uncertainty (bootstrapping and linear fits through the left and right sides of the peak).
	-	Build networks that connect identified IsoFrac peaks to known database proteins (by shared peptide sequences).
	-	Provide quality scores and false-discovery control (Random Forest / Deep Learning and comparisons to randomized data).
	-	Produce compact tables used by the interactive IsoFrac viewer.

## Initialization  

This chunk sets up the working directory, loads required R packages, and reads previously prepared datasets:
	-	ProteinSequences: Uniprot / reference sequences used for mapping sequences to known proteins.
	-	TableListNormEnsHdbScanMW_noSeq_noMD.rda: the main IsoFrac data structure produced by the compiler step (per-gene peptide tables, clustering results, z-scored traces, etc.).

It also:
	-	Ensures cluster labels are in the expected fields (copies cl_2 into a backup field if needed).
	-	Loads pre-trained molecular-weight (MW) models used later to convert fraction numbers to estimated MW.
	-	Sets parameters such as number of threads, score cutoffs, and whether we run semi-tryptic mode.

This is a one-time setup required before running the PeakFinder analysis.

##  Functions

Below we define helper functions used by the PeakFinder pipeline. For each function the short intent is given so the reader can quickly understand what it does before reading details.
checkClusterLengths

Quick diagnostic: draws a barplot of the number of unique peptide sequences per cluster for nonzero clusters. Use to inspect clustering output quality.

### Isofrac_PeakFinder(it, randomized = FALSE, ...)

High-level per-gene peak finder. For a given gene (indexed by it):
	-	Collects all peptide traces that map to that gene.
	-	For each HDBSCAN cluster inside that gene:
	-	Builds a robust average profile (bootstrap medians).
	-	Smooths and locates candidate peaks using findpeaks.
	-	For each candidate peak:
	-	Fits simple linear models to the left and right flanks of the peak to estimate the peak apex (fraction) and height.
	-	Bootstraps these flank fits to get confidence intervals and SD estimates for fraction and height.
	-	Stores peak metrics and quality features for downstream FDR/prediction.
	-	randomized = TRUE runs the same logic on a randomized cluster assignment (used to build null distributions).

Outputs: a table of peaks for that gene with estimated fraction, MW (later converted), height, bootstrap uncertainty, cluster id, and additional QC features.

Implementation note: we use bootstrapped flank fits rather than complex curve fitting to make the peak location estimation robust to outliers and missing fractions.

### lm_checker(start, end, df, bootstrap=FALSE, ...)

Fit a linear model to a segment of the averaged trace. Returns the fit object and summary plot option. When bootstrap=TRUE it resamples the data segment to estimate variability for slope/intercept.

### lmIntx(fit1, fit2)

Compute the intersection point of two linear fits by algebra (used to estimate the peak apex from left and right flank fits). Returns the x (fraction) and y (height) of the intersection.

### ggtraces(input, ens_identifier)

Build ggplot visualizations of the traces for a single gene and overlay identified peak positions and confidence intervals (used in figures and the viewer).

### NetworkTablesCompiler(ensIT, iprTable)

Make pairwise comparisons of identified peaks for a given gene. Computes statistical tests (Wilcoxon) comparing MW estimates between pairs and packages results for network assembly.

### nw_assembler(...) and nw_plot(...)

Assemble and visualize the bipartite network that connects:
	-	Peptide sequence nodes (clusters / sequences),
	-	IsoFrac peak nodes (compressed MW variants),
	-	Optional database protein nodes (UniProt entries matched by sequence).

### nw_assembler builds the node + edge tables; nw_plot can render them with visNetwork (interactive) or igraph (static) and compute pairwise similarity matrices for nodes.

### traces_info_crawler(input, EnsID, ...)

Helper to filter the IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable for a specific gene (EnsID) and return a small table of peaks that satisfy chosen score and uncertainty cutoffs (used to choose reliable peaks when assembling networks).

```{r Functions}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Quick diagnostic: how many peptide traces contribute to each non-noise cluster?
# Used to inspect whether clustering produces reasonable cluster sizes per gene.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

checkClusterLengths <- function(x){
  barplot(table(x$hdbscanTables[cl_2!=0,length(unique(Seq)),.(cl_2,EnsG)]$V1))
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main PeakFinder routine for one gene.
# For a given ENSG:
#   1) collect peptide traces,
#   2) select HDBSCAN clusters,
#   3) detect peaks within each cluster,
#   4) estimate peak apex by fitting left/right flanks,
#   5) bootstrap apex position and height for uncertainty.
#
# Output:
#   A table of candidate protein isoform peaks for the gene, including
#   peak position, height, bootstrap intervals, and cluster assignment.
#
# randomized = TRUE runs the same logic on randomized cluster assignments
# and is used as a null control for FDR / benchmarking.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Isofrac_PeakFinder_newAlg <- function(it,randomized= F,inputSmall=inputSmall,pathAdd="./",clusterType="cl_2"){
  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(pracma)
  library(parallel)
  
  cat("\r PeakFinder",it)
  # Gene index in the current run
  ens <- ens_vector[it]
  
  # Record which gene is being processed (for traceability / debugging)
  pathname <- paste(pathAdd,"PeakFinder",sep = "/")
  try({
    dir.create(pathname,showWarnings = F)
    nam <- paste("PeakFinder_it",it,sep = "")
    write(c(it,ens),paste(pathname,nam,sep = "/"))
  })
  
  PeaksEnsg <- list(Problem="Yes")
  errorinfo <- try({
    it <<- it
    
    # Select real or randomized traces
    if(randomized){
      # Randomized control: same gene, but cluster labels are randomized
      sel <- inputSmall$dt_gn$ens==ens
      if(all(!sel)){return(NULL)}
      
      hdbscanTable <- inputSmall$hdbscanTables_random[EnsG==ens]
      dt <- inputSmall$TMTSubset_final_singlenorm_zscore[hdbscanTable$id,]
      sel2 <- rep(T,dim(dt)[1])
      
    }else{
      # Real data: gene-specific peptide traces and HDBSCAN cluster assignments
      sel <- inputSmall$dt_gn$ens==ens
      sel[is.na(sel)] <- F
      if(all(!sel)){return(NULL)}
      dt <- inputSmall$TMTSubset_final_singlenorm_zscore[sel,]
      hdbscanTable <- inputSmall$hdbscanTables[EnsG==ens,]
      
      # Match peptide sequences back to HDBSCAN rows
      hdbscanTable <- hdbscanTable[match(inputSmall$InputTable$Sequence[sel],hdbscanTable$Seq)]
      
      # Optional peak/cluster quality filter
      hdbscanTable$FDR_RF[is.na(hdbscanTable$FDR_RF)]<-1
      sel2 <- hdbscanTable$FDR_RF<10 
      sel2[is.na(sel2)] <- F 
    }
    
    # If nothing survives filtering, skip this gene
    if(all(!sel2)){return(NULL)}
    
    library(pracma)
    
    hdbscanTable2 <- hdbscanTable
    dt2 <- dt
    
    # Choose which HDBSCAN clustering to use:
    # cl_2 = main clustering result
    # cl_3 = alternative clustering resolution
    if(clusterType=="cl_2"){
      hdbscanTable2$cl_2[is.na(hdbscanTable2$cl_2)] <- -1
      cls <- setdiff(unique(hdbscanTable2$cl_2),c(0,-1))
      hdbscanTable2$UsedClusters <- hdbscanTable2$cl_2
    }else{
      hdbscanTable2$cl_3[is.na(hdbscanTable2$cl_3)] <- -1
      cls <- setdiff(unique(hdbscanTable2$cl_3),c(0,-1))
      hdbscanTable2$UsedClusters <- hdbscanTable2$cl_3
    }
    
    if(length(cls)==0){
      return(1)
    }
    
    # Process each non-noise cluster separately
    PeaksEnsglist <- lapply(sort(cls),function(clsi){
      cat("\r",clsi)
      clsi <<- clsi
      
      # Extract all peptide traces in this cluster
      temp <- dt2[hdbscanTable2$UsedClusters==clsi,]
      temp$id <- 1:dim(temp)[1]
      
      # Reformat for the peak-finding helper
      temp_melt <- melt(temp,id.vars = "id")
      IdentifyPeaks_SECResults <- IdentifyPeaks_SEC(
        temp = data.table(value=temp_melt$value,Fraction=gsub("V","",temp_melt$variable))
      )
      
      # Candidate peaks and quantile-based cutoffs
      fp2 <- IdentifyPeaks_SECResults$PeakQuantiles
      fp2$StartDiff <- NA
      fp2$EndDiff    <- NA
      fp2$PeakSD     <- NA
      fp2$Q0p5CutOff <- NA
      fp2$Q1CutOff   <- NA
      fp2$Q1p5CutOff <- NA
      fp2$Q2CutOff   <- NA
      fp2$Median     <- NA
      fp2$Smooth     <- T
      fp <- fp2
      
      if(length(fp)>0){
        
        # Peak apex and confidence are estimated from left/right flank fits
        Peaks <- sapply(1:dim(fp)[1],function(it,plotstuff=FALSE){
          PositionTable <- rep(NA,9)
          try({
            x <- unlist(fp[it,])
            
            # Linear fit on left flank and right flank
            lm_1 <- lm_checker(x[3],x[2],temp)
            lm_2 <- lm_checker(x[2],x[4],temp,cutatstart = F)
            
            # Intersection of the two fitted lines = peak apex
            CoefReal <- lmIntx(lm_1$md,lm_2$md)
            
            # Bootstrap the flank fits to estimate uncertainty
            lm_bs <- sapply(1:20,function(it){
              lm_1 <- lm_checker(x[3],x[2],temp,bootstrap = T)
              lm_2 <- lm_checker(x[2],x[4],temp,bootstrap = T,cutatstart = F)
              if(is.na(lm_1$md$coefficients[2])|is.na(lm_2$md$coefficients[2])){
                CoefReal <- data.frame(x=NA,y=NA)
              }else{ 
                CoefReal <- lmIntx(lm_1$md,lm_2$md)
              }
              unlist(CoefReal)
            })
            quantile_80 <- apply(lm_bs,1,quantile,probs=c(0.1,0.9),na.rm = T)
            sd_80 <- apply(lm_bs,1,function(x){sd(x,na.rm=T)})
            
            # Peak feature table
            PositionTable <- cbind(
              CoefReal,
              t(as.matrix(as.vector(quantile_80))),
              lm_1$n,
              t(as.matrix(as.vector(sd_80)))
            )
            names(PositionTable) <- c(
              "Fraction_lm","Height_lm",
              "Fraction_BS_lo","Fraction_BS_hi",
              "Height_BS_lo","Height_BS_hi",
              "n","Fraction_sd_80","Height_sd_80"
            )
            PositionTable$Fraction_width <- diff(c(PositionTable$Fraction_BS_lo,PositionTable$Fraction_BS_hi))
            PositionTable$Height_width   <- diff(c(PositionTable$Height_BS_lo,PositionTable$Height_BS_hi))
          })
          
          cbind(t(as.matrix(x)),PositionTable)
        })
        
        Peaks <- t(Peaks)
        Peaks <- data.frame(Peaks)
      }else{
        return(NULL)
      }
      
      Peaks$cluster2 <- clsi
      Peaks
    })
    
    # Keep only sufficiently supported peaks
    PeaksEnsglist2 <<- PeaksEnsglist
    PeaksEnsg <- rbindlist(PeaksEnsglist[lengths(PeaksEnsglist)>11])
    PeaksEnsg$ENS <- ens
  })
  
  # Attach error info if something failed
  if(class(errorinfo)=="try-error"){
    PeaksEnsg$Details <- errorinfo
  }
  PeaksEnsg
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Compute the intersection point of two linear fits.
# Used to estimate peak apex from left and right flank models.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

lmIntx <- function(fit1, fit2, rnd=2) {
  b1<- fit1$coefficient[1]
  m1<- fit1$coefficient[2]
  b2<- fit2$coefficient[1]
  m2<- fit2$coefficient[2]
  df <- data.frame(x=NA, y=NA)
  
  if(m1==m2 & b1==b2) {
    print("Lines are identical")
  } else if(m1==m2 & b1 != b2) {
    print("Lines are parallel")
  } else {
    x <- (b2-b1)/(m1-m2)
    y <- m1*x + b1
    df <- data.frame(x=round(x, rnd), y=round(y, rnd))
  }
  df
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Fit a line to the left or right flank of a candidate peak.
# Used to estimate peak apex and to bootstrap the uncertainty of the apex.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

lm_checker <- function(start,end,df,bootstrap=F,rangeCutoff = 3,cutatstart=T,ggplotstuff=F){

  x1 <- start:end
  if(cutatstart){
    if(diff(range(x1))>rangeCutoff){
      x1 <- (start+rangeCutoff-1):end
    }
  }else{
    if(diff(range(x1))>rangeCutoff){
      x1 <- (start):(end-rangeCutoff+1)
    }
  }
  
  x1_all <- lapply(x1,function(itx){
    data.frame(itx,data.frame(df)[,itx])
  })
  x_all <- lapply(1:dim(df)[2],function(itx){
    data.frame(itx,data.frame(df)[,itx])
  })
  x_all <- rbindlist(x_all)
  x1_all <- rbindlist(x1_all)
  
  if(bootstrap){
    s <- sample(1:dim(x1_all)[1],replace = T)
    lm_md <- lm(as.numeric(unlist(x1_all[s,2]))~as.numeric(unlist(x1_all[s,1])))
  }else{
    lm_md <- lm(as.numeric(unlist(x1_all[,2]))~as.numeric(unlist(x1_all[,1])))
  }
  
  names(x_all) <- c("V1","V2")
  names(x1_all) <- c("V1","V2")
  
  g <- NA
  try({
    coef <- coefficients(lm_md)
    g <- ggplot(x_all,aes(V1,V2))+geom_point()+geom_abline(slope=coef[2],intercept = coef[1])+geom_vline(xintercept = range(x1),lty= "dotted")
    if(ggplotstuff){
      print(g)
    }
  })
  
  list(md=lm_md,x1_all=x1_all,g=g,n=dim(x1_all)[1])
}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot peptide traces and overlay peak positions / uncertainty bars.
# Used for QC and for example figures in the manuscript / viewer.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

ggtraces <- function(input,ens_identifier="ENSG00000120802"){
  PeakResults_TMPO<- data.table(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable)[ENS==ens_identifier]
  PeakResults_TMPO$id <- PeakResults_TMPO$cluster2
  PeakResults_TMPO$cl <- PeakResults_TMPO$cluster2
  
  g2 <- Traces_GGplot(input)
  g3 <- NULL
  try({
    g3 <- g2+
      geom_errorbar(
        data=PeakResults_TMPO,
        aes(x=10^unlist(MW_lm),y=unlist(Height_lm),ymin=unlist(Height_BS_lo),ymax=unlist(Height_BS_hi)),
        color="black"
      )+
      geom_errorbarh(
        data=PeakResults_TMPO,
        aes(x=10^unlist(MW_lm),y=unlist(Height_lm),xmin=10^unlist(MW_lm_lo),xmax=10^unlist(MW_lm_hi)),
        color="black"
      )+
      xlab("log10 MW")+ylab("cluster zscore [au]")+
      geom_label_repel(
        data=PeakResults_TMPO,
        aes(x=10^unlist(MW_lm),y=unlist(Height_lm),label=round(10^unlist(MW_lm))),
        size = 2
      )+
      geom_point(
        data=PeakResults_TMPO,
        aes(10^unlist(MW_lm),unlist(Height_lm),label=round(10^unlist(MW_lm)),group=NULL,color=as.character(cluster2)),
        color="black"
      )
  })
  
  list(Traces=g2,TraceAndPoints=g3)
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build pairwise peak-comparison tables for one gene.
# Used to compare peak candidates within the same gene based on estimated MW,
# fraction width, and cluster quality.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

NetworkTablesCompiler <- function(ensIT="ENSG00000120802",iprTable){
  library(data.table)
  cat("\r",ensIT)
  temp <- iprTable[ENS==ensIT]
  
  if(dim(temp)[1]>1){
    co <- combn(1:dim(temp)[1],2)
  }else{
    co <- matrix(rep(1,2),ncol=1)
  }
  temp$FractionWidth = unlist(temp$End)-unlist(temp$Start)
  
  Mix <- apply(co,2,function(x){
    x <<- x
    a <- temp[x[1]]
    b <- temp[x[2]]
    li <- list(
      c(a$MW_lm,a$MW_lm_gel_hi,a$MW_lm_gel_lo,a$MW_lm_hi,a$MW_lm_lo),
      c(b$MW_lm,b$MW_lm_gel_hi,b$MW_lm_gel_lo,b$MW_lm_hi,b$MW_lm_lo)
    )
    
    p <- as.double(NA)
    p2 <- as.double(NA)
    try({ p  <- wilcox.test(li[[1]],li[[2]])$p.value },silent = T)
    try({ p2 <- wilcox.test(li[[1]][c(1,4,5)],li[[2]][c(1,4,5)])$p.value },silent = T)
    
    t1 <- cbind(a$MW_lm,a$MW_lm,1,1 ,a$Cluster_FDR_RF,a$Cluster_FDR_RF,unlist(a$Height),a$FractionWidth,a$cluster2,length(li[[1]]),length(li[[1]]),a$id,a$id)
    t2 <- cbind(b$MW_lm,b$MW_lm,1,1 ,b$Cluster_FDR_RF,b$Cluster_FDR_RF,unlist(b$Height),b$FractionWidth,b$cluster2,length(li[[2]]),length(li[[2]]),b$id,b$id)
    t3 <- cbind(a$MW_lm,b$MW_lm,p,p2,a$Cluster_FDR_RF,b$Cluster_FDR_RF,min(unlist(c(a$Height,b$Height))),max(c(a$FractionWidth,b$FractionWidth)),paste(a$cluster2,b$cluster2,collapse=";"),length(li[[1]]),length(li[[2]]),a$id,b$id)
    r <- rbind(t1,t2,t3)
    
    colnames(r) <- c("from", "to","p","p2","Cl_FDR1","Cl_FDR2","mpw","FractionWidth","Cluster","n1","n2","id1","id2")
    as.data.table(r)
  })
  
  Mix <- rbindlist(Mix)
  Mix <- unique(Mix)
  list(networkTable=Mix,ens=ensIT)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Build a bipartite network for one gene:
#   peptide sequences -> IsoFrac peak candidates -> optional UniProt entries
#
# This is used for visualization and for summarizing how peptide evidence links
# IsoFrac peaks to database proteins.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

nw_assembler <- function(input,EnsID,traces_info=NULL,cbPalette =c( "#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#F0E442", "#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#CC79A7"),
                         nodeColors = list(isofrac="#E69F00",db="#CC79A7"),
                         ProteinSequences=NULL,applyCutoffs=T
){
  ip <- input$IdentifiedPeaks_Table
  hdbscan <- input$hdbscanTables[EnsG==EnsID,,]
  ipseub <- ip[ENS==EnsID]
  if(dim(ipseub)[1]==0){
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Optional filtering by peak quality / trace support
  if(length(traces_info)>0&applyCutoffs){
    ipseub[,Sel :={
      tr <- traces_info[Height==Height&
                        cluster2==unlist(cluster2)&
                        Peak==unlist(Peak),]
      dim(tr)[1]>0
    },.(Height=unlist(Height),cluster2=unlist(cluster2),Peak=unlist(Peak))]
    ipseub <- ipseub[Sel==TRUE,]
  }
  if(dim(ipseub)[1]==0){
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Map each IsoFrac peak candidate to the peptide sequences supporting it
  CombiVec <- ipseub[,.(Seq={
    hdbscan[cl_2==.BY$cluster2]$Seq
  }),.(cluster2,Compressed_MW_Variants,MW_lm_Compressed_)]
  
  # Network nodes:
  # - peptide sequences
  # - IsoFrac peak candidates
  # - optional UniProt proteins that match the same sequences
  nw_nodes1 <- CombiVec[,.(id=.BY$Seq,
                           value=0,
                           label=.BY$Seq,
                           color=colorRampPalette(cbPalette)(max(CombiVec$cluster2))[unique(cluster2)],
                           group="Seq",shape="dot"),Seq]
  
  nw_nodes2 <- CombiVec[,.(id=.BY$Compressed_MW_Variants,
                           shape="square",
                           color=nodeColors$isofrac,
                           value=round(10^round(.BY$MW_lm_Compressed_,2),-3),
                           label=paste("IsoFrac",paste(round(10^round(.BY$MW_lm_Compressed_,2),-3),"Da"),sep = " # "),
                           group="MQ",value=0),.(Compressed_MW_Variants,MW_lm_Compressed_)]
  
  # Optional database nodes
  if(length(ProteinSequences)>0){
    EnsVec <- ProteinSequences[ENSG==ensVec]
    if(dim(EnsVec)[1]==0){
      return(NULL)
    }
    EnsVecFun <- lapply(hdbscan$Seq,function(x){
      EnsVecFun <- EnsVec[grep(x,EnsVec$SEQUENCE,fixed = T),]
      EnsVecFun$Seq <- x
      unique(EnsVecFun)
    })
    EnsVecFun <- unique(rbindlist(EnsVecFun))
    nw_nodes3 <- data.table(id=paste("UniProt",round(EnsVecFun$MW,-3)),
                            shape = "triangle",
                            group="UniProt",
                            value=round(EnsVecFun$MW,-3),
                            color=nodeColors$db,
                            label=paste(EnsVecFun$ProteinID,paste(round(EnsVecFun$MW,-3),"Da"),sep = " # "))
    nw_nodes3 <- unique(nw_nodes3)
  }else{
    nw_nodes3 <- NULL
  }
  
  nw_nodes <- rbind(nw_nodes1,nw_nodes2,nw_nodes3,fill=T)
  
  edges <- data.frame(from = CombiVec$Seq, to = CombiVec$Compressed_MW_Variants)
  if(length(nw_nodes3)>0){
    edges2 <- data.frame(from = EnsVecFun$Seq, to = paste("UniProt",round(EnsVecFun$MW,-3)))
    edges <- rbind(edges,edges2)
  }
  
  # Simplified table for export / viewer
  CombiVec$MW <- NA
  CombiVec$Score <- NA
  setcolorder(CombiVec,c("Seq","cluster2","MW","MW_lm_Compressed_","Score"))
  AssembledTable <- CombiVec
  names(AssembledTable) <- c("Seq","Cl","MW","MW_obs","Score","Cl_variants")
  
  list(edges=edges,nodes=nw_nodes,AssembledTable=AssembledTable)
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Plot the network created by nw_assembler().
# Supports either visNetwork (interactive) or igraph (static / similarity matrix).
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

nw_plot <- function(nw_assembler_output,NetSet="Both",nodeColors = list(isofrac="#E69F00",db="#CC79A7"),type="VizPlot",addedInfo="UniProt"){
  v=NULL
  p=NULL
  nw <- nw_assembler_output
  
  if(type=="VizPlot"&require(visNetwork)){
    if(NetSet=="Both"){
      sel <- rep(T,dim(nw$nodes)[1])
    }
    if(NetSet=="Ensembl"){
      sel <- grepl(paste(addedInfo,"|Seq"),nw$nodes$group)
    }
    if(NetSet=="IsoFrac"){
      sel <- grepl("MQ|Seq",nw$nodes$group)
    }
    
    v <- visNetwork(edges = nw$edges,nodes=nw$nodes[sel,]) %>% visOptions(manipulation = TRUE)
    v <- v%>%visGroups(groupname = "Uniprot", color = nodeColors$isofrac,shape="square") %>%
      visGroups(groupname = "IsoFrac", color = nodeColors$db,shape="triangle") %>%visLegend() 
  }
  
  if(type=="igraph"&require(igraph)){
    nw_edges <- nw$edges
    v <- graph_from_data_frame(nw_edges,directed = F)
    
    # Color and shape nodes based on their group
    co <- sapply(attributes(V(v))$names,function(x){
      nw$nodes[id==x]$color
    })
    sh <- sapply(attributes(V(v))$names,function(x){
      nw$nodes[id==x]$shape
    })
    
    co[lengths(co)==0] <- "grey"
    sh[lengths(sh)==0] <- "circle"
    sh <- unlist(sh)
    sh[sh=="triangle"] <- "square"
    sh[sh=="dot"] <- "circle"
    
    V(v)$color <- unlist(co)
    V(v)$shape <- unlist(sh)
    V(v)$size=5
    V(v)$label.cex=0.4
    V(v)$label.dist = 1
    
    # Similarity matrix for non-peptide nodes
    Vertice <- V(v)
    NodesOfInterest <- nw$nodes[shape!="dot",]
    Label <- paste(NodesOfInterest$id)
    sel <- which(!is.na(match(attributes(Vertice)$name,Label)))
    v_simi <- igraph::similarity(v,V(v)[sel])
    
    p <- NULL
    try({
      colnames(v_simi) <- nw$nodes[match(attributes(V(v)[sel])$names,id)]$label
      rownames(v_simi) <- nw$nodes[match(attributes(V(v)[sel])$names,id)]$label
      p <- pheatmap(v_simi,silent = T)
    })
    
    # Convert similarity matrix into a long table for downstream interpretation
    si_list <- NULL
    try({
      si_list <- lapply(2:dim(v_simi)[2],function(it){
        si <- v_simi[1:(it-1),it]
        co_ori <- rownames(v_simi)[1:(it-1)]
        co2_ori <- colnames(v_simi)[it]
        co <- strsplit(co_ori," # ")
        co2 <- strsplit(co2_ori," # ")
        
        data.frame(I1=co_ori,                
                   I2=co2_ori,
                   T1=sapply(co,"[[",1),
                   T2=sapply(co2,"[[",1),
                   MW1=gsub(" Da","",sapply(co,"[[",2)),
                   MW2=gsub(" Da","",sapply(co2,"[[",2)),
                   similarity=si)
      })
      si_list <- rbindlist(si_list)
      si_list$Delta_MW <- as.numeric(si_list$MW1)-as.numeric(si_list$MW2)
    })
    
    list(v=v,p=p,type=type,simi_matrix=v_simi,simiList =si_list)
  }
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Filter a peak table for one gene and return peaks in a requested score / SD range.
# Used to pick candidate peaks for network assembly and manual inspection.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

traces_info_crawler <- function(input,EnsID="ENSG00000120802",seqFDR=1,sd80=c(0,2),PeakScore=0.15){
  PeakResults_TMPO <- data.table(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable)[ENS==EnsID]
  PeakResults_TMPO$id <- PeakResults_TMPO$cluster2
  PeakResults_TMPO$cl <- PeakResults_TMPO$cluster2 
  
  # Filter on bootstrap-based fraction uncertainty
  PeakResults_TMPOfil <- PeakResults_TMPO
  PeakResults_TMPOfil <- PeakResults_TMPOfil[unlist(Fraction_sd_80)>=sd80[1]&unlist(Fraction_sd_80)<=sd80[2]]
  PeakResults_TMPOfil
}



## New Functions for new PeakfinderAlgorithm

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# HZ_Smooth
# Lightweight smoothing of fraction traces before peak detection.
# - Sorts fractions if an order vector is provided.
# - Applies a simple 3-point moving average twice.
# - Used to reduce local jitter while preserving the overall elution shape.
# - Returns the smoothed trace together with the original order.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

HZ_Smooth <- function(x, OrderVec=NULL, window=1){
  initialid <- 1:length(x)

  # If a fraction order vector is provided, sort trace values by fraction order
  if(length(OrderVec) == length(x)){
    sortVec <- order(as.numeric(OrderVec))
    x <- x[sortVec]
    initialid <- initialid[sortVec]
    OrderVec <- OrderVec[sortVec]
  }

  id <- 1:length(x)

  # First smoothing pass: mean of each point and its immediate neighbors
  av <- sapply(id, function(y){
    sel <- id >= (y-1) & id <= (y+1)
    hu <- x[sel]
    mean(hu, na.rm = TRUE)
  })

  # Second smoothing pass on the already smoothed trace
  av2 <- sapply(id, function(y){
    sel <- id >= (y-1) & id <= (y+1)
    hu <- av[sel]
    mean(hu, na.rm = TRUE)
  })

  df <- data.table(original = x, OrderVec = OrderVec, av1 = av, av2 = av2, id = initialid)
  df[order(id),]
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# findpeaks_mod_v2
# Wrapper around pracma::findpeaks for fraction-based traces.
# - Collapses peptide traces to a median profile per fraction.
# - Detects local maxima on the smoothed / summarized trace.
# - Converts peak positions back to the original fraction labels.
#
# In IsoFrac PeakFinder, this is used to identify candidate protein isoform peaks
# from peptide clusters within a gene.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

findpeaks_mod_v2 <- function(x, OrderVec=NULL, ...){
  require(pracma)

  input <- data.table(Median_Intensity_2 = x, variable = OrderVec)
  input$OrderVec <- as.numeric(as.character(input$OrderVec))

  # Median signal per fraction
  Median_Matrix <- input[, median(Median_Intensity_2, na.rm = TRUE), variable]
  Median_Matrix <- Median_Matrix[order(variable)]

  # Peak detection on the fraction profile
  Peaks <- findpeaks(as.numeric(Median_Matrix$V1), ...)
  if(length(Peaks) > 0){
    colnames(Peaks) <- c("Intensity", "Peak", "Start", "End")
    Peaks <- data.table(Peaks)

    # Map peak coordinates back to fraction labels
    Peaks$Peak  <- Median_Matrix[Peaks$Peak]$variable
    Peaks$Start <- Median_Matrix[Peaks$Start]$variable
    Peaks$End   <- Median_Matrix[Peaks$End]$variable
  }

  Peaks
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# IdentifyPeaks_SEC
# Main peak-identification routine for one cluster of peptide traces.
#
# Purpose:
# - Start from a set of peptide fraction traces for one HDBSCAN cluster.
# - Smooth the traces lightly.
# - Build a z-scored consensus trace.
# - Detect initial candidate peaks.
# - Refine each peak with a Gaussian-like model and bootstrap-based uncertainty.
#
# Output:
# - PeakQuantiles: table of candidate protein isoform peaks with uncertainty,
#   model fit statistics, and peak positions.
# - MDResults: list of fitted peak models / diagnostics.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

IdentifyPeaks_SEC <- function(temp, bs = 20){
  # temp must contain at least:
  #   - value: peptide intensity
  #   - Fraction or OrderVec: fraction index / order of fractions
  ick <<- temp

  # If no explicit order vector is provided, use the fraction number
  if(length(temp$OrderVec) == 0){
    temp$OrderVec <- as.numeric(temp$Fraction)
  }

  # Smooth the trace before peak detection
  SmoothedData <- HZ_Smooth(temp$value, temp$OrderVec)

  # Store smoothed traces back into the table
  temp$av1 <- SmoothedData[order(OrderVec)]$av1
  temp$av2 <- SmoothedData[order(OrderVec)]$av2

  # Z-score the smoothed profile so peak shape matters more than absolute scale
  temp$av2_zscore <- scale(temp$av2)

  # Initial peak detection on the z-scored smoothed consensus profile
  Peaks_init <- findpeaks_mod_v2(temp$av2_zscore, as.numeric(temp$Fraction), nups = 2, ndowns = 2)
  if(any(class(Peaks_init) == "NULL")){
    Peaks_init <- data.table()
  }
  Peaks_init$Type <- Peaks_init$Peak

  # Margin around the detected peak used for refinement
  marginAdd <- 3
  Peaks <- data.table()

  if(dim(Peaks_init)[1] > 0){

    # Bootstrap the cluster profile to estimate how stable each peak is
    PeakList_bs_all <- lapply(1:bs, function(x){
      tempSampled <- temp[sample(1:dim(temp)[1], replace = TRUE)]
      tempSampled$variable <- as.numeric(as.character(tempSampled$OrderVec))

      # Re-evaluate each initial peak on the resampled trace
      PeaksPoint <- lapply(1:dim(Peaks_init)[1], function(i){
        try({
          tempi <- tempSampled[
            variable >= (Peaks_init[i]$Start - marginAdd) &
            variable <= (Peaks_init[i]$End + marginAdd)
          ]
        })

        PeaksTemp <- NULL
        try({
          PeaksTemp <- findpeaks_mod_v2(
            tempi$av2_zscore,
            as.numeric(tempi$OrderVec),
            nups = 2,
            ndowns = 2
          )
          if(length(PeaksTemp) > 0){
            PeaksTemp$Type <- Peaks_init[i]$Peak
            PeaksTemp$Height <- Peaks_init[i]$Intensity
          }
        }, silent = TRUE)

        PeaksTemp
      })

      PeaksPoint <- rbindlist(PeaksPoint, fill = TRUE)
      Peaks <- rbind(Peaks, PeaksPoint, fill = TRUE)

      if(dim(Peaks)[1] == 0){
        Peaks <- NULL
      }

      Peaks
    })

  }else{
    PeakList_bs_all <- list()
  }

  # Combine bootstrap peak calls
  PeakDt <- rbindlist(PeakList_bs_all, fill = TRUE)

  # Quantiles of peak position from bootstrap replicates
  PeakQuantiles <- NULL
  try({
    if(dim(PeakDt)[1] > 0){
      PeakQuantiles <- PeakDt[, as.list(quantile(Peak, c(0.1, 0.9), na.rm = TRUE)), .(Type, Height)]
    }
  })

  # Attach bootstrap quantiles to the initial peak table
  PeakQuantiles_v2 <- cbind(Peaks_init, PeakQuantiles[match(Peaks_init$Peak, PeakQuantiles$Type)])

  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # PeakCheck:
  # Fit a Gaussian-like model to the peak region.
  # This is used as a shape check and to quantify how well the peak resembles
  # a smooth, centered protein isoform signal.
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------

  PeakCheck <- function(x, y){
    shiftvalue <- 0
    if(any(y < 0)){
      shiftvalue <- abs(min(y)) + 0.000001
    }
    y <- y + shiftvalue

    # Keep only positive values for fitting
    valid <- y > 0
    x_valid <- x[valid]
    y_valid <- y[valid]
    y_valid <- y_valid / max(y_valid)

    gauss_model_centered <- list()
    gauss_model <- list()

    if(length(x) > 3){
      rm("gauss_model_centered")

      # Centered Gaussian: x is already shifted around the peak apex
      try({
        error <- TRUE
        sigmavalue <- 0
        while(error){
          sigmavalue <- sigmavalue + 1
          test <- try({
            gauss_model_centered <- nls(
              y_valid ~ A * exp(- x_valid^2 / (2 * sigma^2)),
              start = list(A = 0.1, sigma = sigmavalue),
              lower = list(A = -10, sigma = 1e-6),
              upper = list(A = 10, sigma = 100),
              algorithm = "port"
            )
          })
          if(class(test) != "try-error" | sigmavalue > 50){
            error <- FALSE
          }
        }
      })

      # Non-centered Gaussian: estimate a free mean (mu) as a reference fit
      try({
        mydata <- data.frame(x = x_valid, y = y_valid)
        gauss_model <- nls(
          y ~ A * exp(- (x - mu)^2 / (2 * sigma^2)),
          data = mydata,
          start = list(A = max(mydata$y), mu = mean(mydata$x), sigma = sd(mydata$x)),
          lower = list(A = -Inf, mu = min(mydata$x), sigma = 1e-6),
          upper = list(A = Inf, mu = max(mydata$x), sigma = Inf),
          algorithm = "port"
        )
      })
    }

    # Predicted values for both fits
    try({ p  <- predict(gauss_model_centered, x_valid) })
    try({ p2 <- predict(gauss_model, x_valid) })

    # Residual / fit quality for centered model
    try({
      y_pred <- p
      residuals <- y_valid - y_pred
    })
    rss <- as.double(NA)
    tss <- as.double(NA)
    try({
      rss <- sum(residuals^2)
      tss <- sum((y_valid - mean(y_valid))^2)
    })

    sigma <- as.double(NA)
    r_squared <- as.double(NA)
    try({
      r_squared <- 1 - rss / tss
      sigma <- summary(gauss_model_centered)$sigma
    })

    y_predicted <- as.double(NA)
    try({
      y_predicted <- predict(gauss_model_centered) * max(y)
    })

    # Residual / fit quality for non-centered model
    try({
      y_pred2 <- p2
      residuals2 <- y_valid - y_pred2
    })
    rss2 <- as.double(NA)
    tss2 <- as.double(NA)
    try({
      rss2 <- sum(residuals2^2)
      tss2 <- sum((y_valid - mean(y_valid))^2)
    })

    sigma2 <- as.double(NA)
    r_squared2 <- as.double(NA)
    try({
      r_squared2 <- 1 - rss / tss
      sigma2 <- summary(gauss_model)$sigma
    })

    y_predicted2 <- as.double(NA)
    try({
      y_predicted2 <- predict(gauss_model, y_valid)
      y_predicted2 <- y_predicted2 * max(y)
    })

    Peak_fit <- NA
    try({
      Peak_fit <- coef(gauss_model)["A"]
    })

    # Return fit diagnostics for one peak
    list(
      sigma = sigma,
      r_squared = r_squared,
      md = gauss_model_centered,
      x_valid = x_valid,
      shiftvalue = shiftvalue,
      y_predicted = y_predicted,
      sigma_nc = sigma2,
      r_squared_nc = r_squared2,
      md_nc = gauss_model,
      y_predicted_nc = y_predicted2,
      Peak_fit = Peak_fit
    )
  }

  # Wrapper: apply PeakCheck to a given peak window
  PeakCheck_Wrapper <- function(x, fraction, gr){
    nls_results <- NULL
    try({
      print(gr)
      tempfun <- data.table(value = x, variable = as.numeric(fraction))
      tempii <<- tempfun[
        as.numeric(variable) >= (as.numeric(gr$Start) - marginAdd) &
        as.numeric(variable) <= (as.numeric(gr$End) + marginAdd)
      ]
      tempii$variable <- as.numeric(as.character(tempii$variable))
      nls_results <- PeakCheck(as.numeric(as.character(tempii$variable)) - gr$Peak, tempii$value)
    })
    nls_results
  }

  # Peak-specific Gaussian fit results
  PeakQuantilesTemp <- lapply(split(Peaks_init, Peaks_init$Peak), function(gr){
    gr <- gr
    nls_results <- list()

    try({
      nls_results <- PeakCheck_Wrapper(temp$av2_zscore, temp$OrderVec, gr)

      # Quick diagnostic plot object stored in the results
      nls_results$Peak <- ggplot(temp, aes(as.numeric(OrderVec), av2_zscore)) +
        geom_point() +
        geom_line(
          data = data.frame(a = nls_results$x_valid + gr$Peak, b = nls_results$y_predicted, id = NA),
          aes(x = a, y = b),
          color = "darkorange", lwd = 1, lty = "solid"
        ) +
        geom_line(
          data = data.frame(a = nls_results$x_valid + gr$Peak, b = nls_results$y_predicted_nc, id = NA),
          aes(x = a, y = b),
          color = "turquoise", lwd = 1, lty = "dotted"
        )
    })

    nls_results$X_shift <- gr$Peak
    nls_results
  })

  # Attach fit statistics to the peak table
  if(length(PeakQuantiles_v2$Type) != 0){
    PeakQuantiles_v2[, c("r.squared","sigma","x_shift") := {
      si <- as.double(NA)
      rs <- as.double(NA)
      PeakShift <- as.double(NA)
      gr <- .BY

      if(!is.na(as.numeric(gr$Type))){
        pa <- PeakQuantilesTemp[[which(gr$Type == as.numeric(names(PeakQuantilesTemp)))]]

        try({ si <- pa$sigma })
        try({ rs <- pa$r_squared })
        try({
          if(length(pa$Peak_fit) > 0){
            PeakShift <- pa$Peak_fit
          }
        })
      }

      list(si, rs, PeakShift)
    }, Type]
  }

  # Final output:
  # - PeakQuantiles: peak table with bootstrap and fit metrics
  # - MDResults: per-peak Gaussian model diagnostics
  list(PeakQuantiles = PeakQuantiles_v2, MDResults = PeakQuantilesTemp)
}
```

## PeakFinder
This section runs the full peak-finding pipeline for all genes in each experiment (gel). High-level steps:
	1.	Initialize h2o (for peak-quality prediction) and required parallel resources.
	2.	Load and merge peak candidate sets created from forward and reverse trace analyses (these form positive and negative training sets for PeakFDR).
	3.	For each gene:
	  -	Build a robust average profile across peptides in the selected cluster(s).
	  -	Detect candidate peaks (local maxima) on the average profile.
	  -	For each candidate peak: fit left and right flank LM, bootstrap to estimate uncertainty in fraction & height.
	  -	Store a rich set of features for each peak (height, fraction, fraction width, bootstrap SD, cluster FDR measures, etc.).
	4.	Convert fraction coordinates into estimated MWs by applying pre-trained MW models for each gel.
	5.	Collapse similar peaks across the same gene into “Compressed MW Variants” (peak identity clustering) using network clique finding on similarity of fraction positions.
	6.	Run PeakQuality models (Random Forest / Deep Learning) trained on simulated “good” and “bad” peaks to assign a data-driven peak score.
	7.	Save the results and export a slimmed object.

Important design choices explained simply:
	  -	We use average profiles (bootstrap median across peptides) because single peptides are noisy. Taking a median across resampled subsets improves robustness.
	  -	Peak apex estimation relies on the intersection of two linear fits to the left and right flanks. This is a simple, interpretable way to estimate apex fraction even with partially missing data.
	  -	Bootstrapping flank fits gives confidence intervals (we report fraction and height CI), which are used to filter unreliable peaks.
	  -	We compare real data to randomized cluster assignments to get a null distribution and estimate FDR-like behavior for peak features.

```{r PeakFinder}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# PeakFinder driver script
#
# This block runs the full PeakFinder workflow for all gels / experiments:
#   1) train an HDBSCAN-based peak-quality classifier,
#   2) estimate FDR for candidate peaks,
#   3) run the per-gene peak finder,
#   4) compress redundant peaks into IsoFrac protein isoform candidates,
#   5) store the results for the viewer and downstream analysis.
#
# The workflow is applied separately to each gel / experiment.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

threads <- 100
dir.create("Peakfinder")
setwd("Peakfinder")

# In some runs the first entry is a helper object and is removed here.
if(length(TableListNormEnsHdbScanMW_noSeq_noMD) == 4){
  TableListNormEnsHdbScanMW_noSeq_noMD <- TableListNormEnsHdbScanMW_noSeq_noMD[2:4]
}

lapply(TableListNormEnsHdbScanMW_noSeq_noMD, function(x){ x$xname })
input <- TableListNormEnsHdbScanMW_noSeq_noMD[[2]]
input$xname

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main PeakFinder loop over all gels
# - Each input object contains gene-centric peptide traces and HDBSCAN clusters.
# - For each gel, we train / apply a peak-quality model and then run PeakFinder.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

if(!file.exists("TableListNormEnsHdbScanMW_Peaks9_newAlg.rda") | rerun){

  getlistNames <- sapply(TableListNormEnsHdbScanMW_noSeq_noMD, function(x){ x$xname })

  TableListNormEnsHdbScanMW_Peaks <- lapply(TableListNormEnsHdbScanMW_noSeq_noMD, function(input){
    setwd(MainWD)

    print("Analysing")
    print(input$xname)
    input <<- input

    # Create a working directory for this gel / experiment
    xname <- gsub(".txt$", "", make.names(input$xname))
    xname <- paste("h2o_FDR_PeakFinder", xname, sep = "_")
    dir.create(xname)
    setwd(xname)

    # HDBSCAN results:
    #   - li1 = randomized control
    #   - li2 = real cluster assignments
    li1 <- input$hdbscanTables_random
    li2 <- input$hdbscanTables

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Train an HDBSCAN cluster classifier (Random Forest / optional DeepLearning)
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    if(!file.exists(paste(".", xname, "TableListNormEnsHdbScan_random_ML.rda", sep = "/")) | rerun){

      dir.create(cuw <- paste("HDBSCAN_ML", sep = "/"))
      wd1 <- getwd()
      wd2 <- getwd()

      # Label real vs randomized rows for supervised training
      li1$Score <- 0
      li2$Score <- 1

      tabi <- rbind(li1, li2)
      tabi$Abu <- as.numeric(as.character(tabi$Abu))
      tabi$Seq <- NULL
      tabi$id <- NULL
      tabi$sc_2[is.na(tabi$sc_2)] <- 0
      tabi$sc_3[is.na(tabi$sc_3)] <- 0

      TrainingFun <- lapply(list(tabi), function(x){
        print("Round")
        xfun <- x
        xfun$EnsG <- NULL
        xfun$cl_2 <- NULL
        xfun$cl_3 <- NULL

        print(dim(xfun))
        print("Training Data")

        # H2O frame for classifier training
        train.h2o <- as.h2o(xfun)

        # Random forest is the main peak-quality model
        print("RandomForest")
        isofrac_rf <- h2o.randomForest(training_frame = train.h2o, y = "Score", nfolds = 10)

        rfname <- paste(
          "ML_hdbscan_rf_",
          paste(c("2","3")[c(any(grepl("2", names(x))), any(grepl("[cps]_3", names(x))))], collapse = "_"),
          sep = ""
        )

        h2o.save_mojo(isofrac_rf, paste(xname, "HDBSCAN_ML", rfname, sep = "/"), force = TRUE)

        # Predict peak quality for all rows
        scores <- predict(isofrac_rf, train.h2o)
        scores <- as.data.frame(scores)
        x$Prediction_rf <- scores$predict

        # Deep learning was tested but not used in the final workflow
        x$Prediction_dl <- 0

        list(x)
      })

      graphics.off()
      setwd("../")
      save(TrainingFun, file = paste(".", xname, "TableListNormEnsHdbScan_random_ML.rda", sep = "/"))

    }else{
      if(basename(getwd()) == xname){
        setwd("../")
      }
      load(paste(".", xname, "TableListNormEnsHdbScan_random_ML.rda", sep = "/"))
    }

    print("loaded TableListNormEnsHdbScan_random_ML")
    graphics.off()

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Evaluate classifier performance and derive an empirical FDR curve
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    library(pROC)

    lapply(TrainingFun, function(y){
      prf <- y[[1]]

      r  <- roc(prf$Score, prf$Prediction_rf)
      dl <- roc(prf$Score, prf$Prediction_dl)

      plot(r, main = "rf")
      points(dl$specificities, dl$sensitivities, col = 2, lty = "dotted", type = "l")
      legend("bottomright", legend = paste(c("RF","DL"), c(round(r$auc,3), round(dl$auc,3))))
      NULL
    })

    # Construct a simple FDR curve from the ranked randomized / real scores
    tabi <- TrainingFun[[1]][[1]]
    FDRtemp <- tabi[order(tabi$Prediction_rf, decreasing = TRUE),]
    wh <- which(FDRtemp$Score == 0)
    fdr <- (1:length(wh)) / wh

    pdf(paste(".", xname, "FDRTest.pdf", sep = "/"))
    plot(FDRtemp$Prediction_rf[wh], fdr, type = "l", main = "Score", lwd = 5)

    dt_fdr <- data.table(score = FDRtemp$Prediction_rf[wh], fdr = fdr, cut = cut(FDRtemp$Prediction_rf[wh], 1000))
    dt_fdr <- dt_fdr[, .(score = mean(score), fdr = mean(fdr)), cut]

    FDRPREDICt <- loess(c(dt_fdr$fdr, rep(0,10)) ~ c(dt_fdr$score, 1.1:10.1), span = 0.3)
    so <- order(FDRPREDICt$x)
    points(FDRPREDICt$x[so], FDRPREDICt$fitted[so], type = "l", col = 2, lty = "solid", lwd = 2)

    abline(h = 0.01)
    abline(h = 0.05)
    abline(h = 0.1)

    tabi$FDR <- predict(FDRPREDICt, TrainingFun[[1]][[1]]$Prediction_rf)
    dev.off()

    # Attach RF-based FDR estimates back to real and randomized HDBSCAN tables
    input$hdbscanTables$FDR_RF <- tabi$FDR[tabi$Score == 1]
    input$hdbscanTables_random$FDR_RF <- tabi$FDR[tabi$Score == 0]

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Summarize number of clusters / isoform candidates per gene under different
    # FDR thresholds. This gives a quick view of how the score cutoff affects yield.
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    il <- input$hdbscanTables

    ISOFORMS <- il[, .(
      all          = length(unique(cl_2 > 0)),
      FDR_RF_1pr   = length(unique(cl_2[FDR_RF < 0.01 & cl_2 != 0])),
      FDR_RF_5pr   = length(unique(cl_2[FDR_RF < 0.05 & cl_2 != 0])),
      FDR_RF_10pr  = length(unique(cl_2[FDR_RF < 0.1  & cl_2 != 0]))
    ), EnsG]

    isomelt <- melt(ISOFORMS)
    isomeltList <- isomelt[, .(
      hu = as.list(table(value)),
      ha = as.list(names(table(value)))
    ), variable]

    pdf(pdfname <- paste(".", xname, "TraceFDR_barplots_Genes.pdf", sep = "/"), width = 10)
    library(gridExtra)
    g1 <- ggplot(isomeltList[grep("1pr", variable)], aes(as.numeric(unlist(ha)), unlist(hu), fill = variable)) +
      geom_bar(position = "dodge", stat = "identity") +
      xlab("HDBSCAN Clusters") + ylab("Genes") + xlim(-1, 10) + ylim(c(0, 9000))
    g2 <- ggplot(isomeltList[grep("5pr", variable)], aes(as.numeric(unlist(ha)), unlist(hu), fill = variable)) +
      geom_bar(position = "dodge", stat = "identity") +
      xlab("HDBSCAN Clusters") + ylab("Genes") + xlim(-1, 10) + ylim(c(0, 9000))
    g3 <- ggplot(isomeltList[grep("10pr", variable)], aes(as.numeric(unlist(ha)), unlist(hu), fill = variable)) +
      geom_bar(position = "dodge", stat = "identity") +
      xlab("HDBSCAN Clusters") + ylab("Genes") + xlim(-1, 10) + ylim(c(0, 9000))
    grid.arrange(g1, g2, g3, nrow = 1)
    dev.off()
    system(paste("open", pdfname))

    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Peak finding per gene
    # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    ens_vector <- unique(input$dt_gn$ens)
    setwd(MainWD)

    rdapath <- paste(".", xname, "PeakFinder_Subset.rda", sep = "/")
    if(!file.exists(rdapath) | rerun){

      PeakFinder <- try({

        graphics.off()
        library(parallel)

        # Build input object for the per-gene PeakFinder routine
        ENs_listpath <- paste(".", xname, "ENS_List.rda", sep = "/")
        if(!file.exists(ENs_listpath) | rerun){

          inputSmall <- list()
          inputSmall$hdbscanTables_random <- input$hdbscanTables_random
          inputSmall$hdbscanTables <- input$hdbscanTables
          inputSmall$TMTSubset_final_singlenorm_zscore <- input$TMTSubset_final_singlenorm_zscore
          inputSmall$dt_gn <- input$dt_gn
          inputSmall$InputTable <- data.frame(Sequence = input$InputTable$Sequence)
          ens_vector <- unique(input$dt_gn$ens)

          try(stopCluster(cl), silent = TRUE)
          print("Starting Cluster")
          cl <- makeCluster(threads, outfile = "outfile.txt")

          if(!file.exists(ENs_listpath)){
            hu <- try({
              save(inputSmall, ens_vector, lmIntx, lm_checker, Isofrac_PeakFinder_newAlg, HZ_Smooth, file = "Isofrac_PeakFinder.rda")
              clusterExport(cl, list("ens_vector", "lmIntx", "lm_checker", "HZ_Smooth", "IdentifyPeaks_SEC", "findpeaks_mod_v2"), envir = environment())

              print("Exported Cluster")

              # Run peak finding on real data
              itvec <- (1:length(unique(ens_vector)))
              ENS_List <- parLapply(cl, itvec, Isofrac_PeakFinder_newAlg, inputSmall = inputSmall, pathAdd = paste(".", xname, sep = "/"))
              save(ENS_List, file = ENs_listpath)

              # Run peak finding on randomized data (null control)
              print("Started Peakfinding cl_2 random")
              ENS_List_rev <- parLapply(cl, sample(itvec), Isofrac_PeakFinder_newAlg, inputSmall = inputSmall, randomized = TRUE, pathAdd = paste(".", xname, sep = "/"))
              save(ENS_List, ENS_List_rev, file = ENs_listpath)

            })

            hu <- try({
              # Alternative HDBSCAN resolution (cl_3)
              print("Started Peakfinding cl_3")
              ENS_List_cl_3 <- parLapply(cl, sample(itvec), Isofrac_PeakFinder_newAlg, inputSmall = inputSmall, pathAdd = paste(".", xname, sep = "/"), clusterType = "cl_3")
              save(ENS_List, ENS_List_rev, ENS_List_cl_3, file = ENs_listpath)

              print("Started Peakfinding cl_3 random")
              ENS_List_rev_cl_3 <- parLapply(cl, sample(itvec), Isofrac_PeakFinder_newAlg, inputSmall = inputSmall, randomized = TRUE, pathAdd = paste(".", xname, sep = "/"), clusterType = "cl_3")
              save(ENS_List, ENS_List_rev, ENS_List_cl_3, ENS_List_rev_cl_3, file = ENs_listpath)
            })
          }else{
            load(ENs_listpath)
          }

          stopCluster(cl)
          rm("cl")
        }else{
          load(ENs_listpath)
        }

        # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        # Convert peak candidates into final IsoFrac peak tables
        # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        Isopath <- paste(".", xname, "IsoFrac_PeakResults.rda", sep = "/")
        if(!file.exists("Isopath") | rerun){

          # Keep only sufficiently well-supported peak objects
          hm <- rbindlist(ENS_List[lengths(ENS_List) > 18], fill = TRUE)
          hm <- as.data.frame(hm)
          hm_rev <- rbindlist(ENS_List_rev[lengths(ENS_List_rev) > 18], fill = TRUE)

          # Training labels for FDR estimation:
          #   score = 1 for real peaks, score = 0 for randomized control peaks
          hm$score <- 1
          hm_rev$score <- 0

          hm_all <- rbind(hm, hm_rev)
          hm_all$ENS <- NULL
          hm_all$Height_SD <- NULL
          hm_all$Height_SD_all <- NULL
          hm_all$Fraction_SD <- NULL
          hm_all$Fraction_SD_all <- NULL
          hm_all$cluster2 <- NULL
          colnames(hm_all)[dupl <- duplicated(colnames(hm_all))]
          if(any(dupl)){
            hm_all <- data.frame(hm_all)[, -dupl]
          }
          hm_all <- as.data.table(hm_all)

          hm_all_temp <- apply(hm_all, 2, function(x){
            x[lengths(x) == 0] <- NA
            xl <- unlist(x)
            if(length(x) != length(xl)){
              stop()
            }
            xl
          })
          hm_all_temp <- data.frame(hm_all_temp)

          h2odt <- as.h2o(hm_all_temp)
          h2odt_md <- h2o.randomForest(training_frame = h2odt, y = "score", nfolds = 10)

          AllScore <- predict(h2odt_md, h2odt)
          AllScore <- as.data.frame(AllScore)
          AllScore$score <- unlist(hm_all$score)

          # Empirical FDR curve
          FDRtemp <- AllScore[order(AllScore$predict, decreasing = TRUE),]
          wh <- which(FDRtemp$score == 0)
          fdr <- 1:length(wh) / wh

          FDRCount <- sapply(seq(0,1,by = 0.01), function(x){
            c(sum(FDRtemp$predict < x), 0, x)
          })
          FDRCount <- t(FDRCount)

          pdf(pdfname <- paste(".", xname, "Scores_Comparisson.pdf", sep = "/"))
          plot(FDRCount[,3], FDRCount[,1], type = "l", xlab = "FDR", ylab = "FDR", xlim = c(0, 0.2), main = "Peak FDR")
          grid()
          points(FDRCount[,3], FDRCount[,2], type = "l", col = 2)
          abline(v = 0.01)
          abline(0, 1)

          plot(FDRtemp$predict[wh], fdr, type = "l", main = "Score", lwd = 5)
          abline(h = 0.01)

          dt_fdr <- data.table(score = FDRtemp$predict[wh], fdr = fdr, cut = cut(FDRtemp$predict[wh], 1000))
          dt_fdr <- dt_fdr[, .(score = mean(score), fdr = mean(fdr)), cut]
          FDRPREDICt <- loess(c(dt_fdr$fdr, rep(0,10)) ~ c(dt_fdr$score, 1.1:10.1), span = 0.3)
          so <- order(FDRPREDICt$x)
          points(FDRPREDICt$x[so], FDRPREDICt$fitted[so], type = "l", col = 2, lty = "solid", lwd = 2)
          abline(h = 0.01)
          abline(h = 0.05)
          abline(h = 0.1)

          h2o.varimp_plot(h2odt_md)

          FDR <- predict(FDRPREDICt, AllScore$predict)
          FDR <- FDR[hm_all$score == 1]
          FDR[FDR < 0] <- 0

          hm$FDR_RF <- FDR
          hm$FDR_DL <- -1

          IsoFrac_PeakResults <- hm
          IsoFrac_PeakResults_random <- hm_rev
          dev.off()

          save(IsoFrac_PeakResults, IsoFrac_PeakResults_random, file = Isopath)
        }else{
          load(Isopath)
        }

        # Store the peak results back in the input object
        input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable <- IsoFrac_PeakResults
        input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random <- IsoFrac_PeakResults_random

        # Clip extreme fraction predictions to remain in the valid gel range
        input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$Fraction_lm[input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$Fraction_lm < -1] <- -1
        input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$Fraction_lm[input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$Fraction_lm > 29] <- 29

        input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$Fraction_BS_lo[input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$Fraction_BS_lo < -3] <- -3
        input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$Fraction_BS_hi[input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$Fraction_BS_hi > 31] <- 31

        input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$Fraction_lm[input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$Fraction_lm < -1] <- -1
        input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$Fraction_lm[input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$Fraction_lm > 29] <- 29

        input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$Fraction_BS_lo[input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$Fraction_BS_lo < -3] <- -3
        input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$Fraction_BS_hi[input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$Fraction_BS_hi > 31] <- 31

        # Load the gel-specific fraction->MW model trained in the compiler step
        if(!exists("Models")){
          load("../IsoFracCompiler/MW_Models_v3.rda")
        }

        Models.i <- Models[[which(input$xname == names(Models))]]
        FractionShift = 0

        # Predict MW and MW uncertainty from fraction position
        input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$MW_lm      <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$Fraction_lm))
        input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$MW_lm_hi   <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$Fraction_BS_hi))
        input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$MW_lm_lo   <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$Fraction_BS_lo))

        input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$MW_lm_gel_hi <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor_addon$hi, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$Fraction_lm) + FractionShift)
        input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$MW_lm_gel_lo <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor_addon$lo, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$Fraction_lm) + FractionShift)

        input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$MW_fr      <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$Fraction_lm) + FractionShift)
        input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$MW_fr_hi   <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$Fraction_BS_hi) + FractionShift)
        input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$MW_fr_lo   <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$Fraction_BS_lo) + FractionShift)

        input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$MW_fr_gel_hi <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor_addon$hi, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$Fraction_lm) + FractionShift)
        input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$MW_fr_gel_lo <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor_addon$lo, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$Fraction_lm) + FractionShift)

        # Same MW predictions for the randomized control table
        input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$MW_lm      <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$Fraction_lm))
        input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$MW_lm_hi   <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$Fraction_BS_hi))
        input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$MW_lm_lo   <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$Fraction_BS_lo))

        input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$MW_lm_gel_hi <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor_addon$hi, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$Fraction_lm) + FractionShift)
        input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$MW_lm_gel_lo <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor_addon$lo, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$Fraction_lm) + FractionShift)

        input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$MW_fr      <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$Fraction_lm) + FractionShift)
        input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$MW_fr_hi   <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$Fraction_BS_hi) + FractionShift)
        input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$MW_fr_lo   <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$Fraction_BS_lo) + FractionShift)

        input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$MW_fr_gel_hi <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor_addon$hi, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$Fraction_lm) + FractionShift)
        input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$MW_fr_gel_lo <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor_addon$lo, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$Fraction_lm) + FractionShift)

        # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        # Compress nearby peak candidates into one IsoFrac protein isoform candidate
        # when they overlap in MW / fraction space.
        # ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
        cl <- makeCluster(2, outfile = "")
        print("Started Compilation of PeakIdentityList.")

        ipr_PeakIdentityList <- lapply(list(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable,
                                            input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random), function(ipr){

          ipr <- as.data.table(ipr)
          library(igraph)
          ipr_PeakIdentity <- ipr[,{
            cat("\r", .BY$ENS)
            temp <- .SD
            temp$id <- 1:dim(temp)[1]

            # Build a graph where peaks are connected if they are close in MW
            Lapi <- lapply(1:dim(temp)[1], function(it){
              i <- temp[it,]
              check <- temp[-it,]
              lifu <- c(unlist(check$Fraction_lm) - unlist(i$Fraction_lm))

              # Only connect peaks that are close in fraction / MW
              tempMix <- check[abs(lifu) < 1,]

              if(dim(tempMix)[1] > 0){
                re <- cbind(
                  unlist(i$Fraction_lm),
                  unlist(tempMix$Fraction_lm),
                  max(abs(lifu)[abs(lifu) < 10], na.rm = TRUE),
                  unlist(i$Height),
                  unlist(i$Peak),
                  unlist(i$Start),
                  unlist(i$End),
                  unlist(i$Fraction_lm),
                  unlist(i$Height_lm),
                  unlist(i$Fraction_BS_hi),
                  unlist(i$Fraction_BS_lo),
                  unlist(i$cluster2),
                  unlist(i$Fraction_sd_80)
                )
                re <- data.frame(re)
              }else{
                re <- cbind(
                  i$Fraction_lm, i$Fraction_lm, 0,
                  unlist(i$Height),
                  unlist(i$Peak),
                  unlist(i$Start),
                  unlist(i$End),
                  unlist(i$Fraction_lm),
                  unlist(i$Height_lm),
                  unlist(i$Fraction_BS_hi),
                  unlist(i$Fraction_BS_lo),
                  unlist(i$cluster2),
                  unlist(i$Fraction_sd_80)
                )
              }
              re
            })

            Netfun <- rbindlist(Lapi)
            g <- graph_from_data_frame(d = Netfun)
            g <- as.undirected(g)

            # Collapse connected components / cliques into one compressed MW variant
            MaxCliques <- maximal.cliques(g)
            le <- lapply(1:length(MaxCliques), function(x){
              data.table(as.numeric(attributes(MaxCliques[[x]])$names), x)
            })
            le <- rbindlist(le)
            colnames(le) <- c("Fraction", "PeakIdentity")
            Mapping <- le[, paste(PeakIdentity, collapse = "_"), Fraction]
            temp$Compressed_MW_Variants <- Mapping$V1[match(temp$Fraction_lm, Mapping$Fraction)]
            temp
          }, ENS]

          # Summarize the compressed peak family by mean / SD MW
          ipr_PeakIdentity[, c("MW_lm_Compressed_", "MW_lm_Compressed_sd") := {
            temp <- .SD
            list(
              as.double(mean(unlist(temp$MW_lm), na.rm = TRUE)),
              as.double(sd(unlist(temp$MW_lm), na.rm = TRUE))
            )
          }, .(ENS, Compressed_MW_Variants)]

          ipr_PeakIdentity
        })

        stopCluster(cl)

        input$IdentifiedPeaks_Table <- ipr_PeakIdentityList[[1]]
        input$IdentifiedPeaks_Table_random <- ipr_PeakIdentityList[[2]]

        print("Finished Compilation of PeakIdentityList.")
        save(input, file = rdapath)
      })

    }else{
      PeakFinder <- try({ load(rdapath) })
    }

    print(paste("Loaded PeakfinderData from", file.info(rdapath)$mtime))

    if(class(PeakFinder) == "try-error"){
      print("!!! WARNING !!!")
      print("Problems in PeakFinder")
      print(input$xname)
    }

    input
  })

  # Save the full result list for later use
  save(TableListNormEnsHdbScanMW_Peaks, file = "TableListNormEnsHdbScanMW_Peaks9_newAlg.rda")
}

```

### PeakFinderRepair

- rerunning after Ens_list.rda and combination of cl2 and cl3

```{r PeakFinder}
### PeakFinderRepair
# Re-run PeakFinder after loading the previously saved ENS_List objects
# and after combining the cl_2 / cl_3 peak-candidate sets.
# This step rebuilds the final IsoFrac peak tables, assigns MW estimates,
# and compresses overlapping peak calls into protein isoform candidates.

options(warn = -1)
h2o.shutdown()
h2o.init()

TableListNormEnsHdbScanMW_Peaks <- lapply(TableListNormEnsHdbScanMW_noSeq_noMD, function(input){

  # Return to the main working directory for each gel/experiment
  setwd(MainWD)

  print("Analysing")
  print(input$xname)

  input <- input

  # Create a gel-specific analysis folder
  xname <- gsub(".txt$", "", make.names(input$xname))
  xname <- paste("h2o_FDR_PeakFinder", xname, sep = "_")

  if(rerun & file.exists(xname)){
    # Optional cleanup of previous run directory could be placed here
  }

  dir.create(xname)
  setwd(xname)
  print(getwd())

  # HDBSCAN outputs:
  #   li1 = randomized control
  #   li2 = real data
  li1 <- input$hdbscanTables_random
  li2 <- input$hdbscanTables
  il  <- input$hdbscanTables

  # Gene list for this gel
  ens_vector <- unique(input$dt_gn$ens)

  # Output file for this gel-specific repaired PeakFinder run
  xname <- input$xname
  rdapath <- paste(".", "PeakFinder_Subset.rda", sep = "/")

  file.exists(rdapath)
  rerun <- TRUE

  if(!file.exists(rdapath) | rerun){
    PeakFinder <- try({

      graphics.off()
      library(parallel)

      # Load the previously generated gene-wise peak lists
      # (real and randomized, cl_2 and cl_3 versions)
      try({
        hu <- load("ENS_List.rda")
      })

      # Rebuild peak tables from the saved ENS_List objects
      Isopath <- "IsoFrac_PeakResults.rda"

      if(!file.exists(Isopath) | rerun){

        # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
        # Combine peak candidates from:
        #   - real data, cl_2
        #   - real data, cl_3
        #   - randomized control, cl_2
        #   - randomized control, cl_3
        # ----------------------------------------------------------------------

        hm <- rbindlist(ENS_List[lengths(ENS_List) > 18], fill = TRUE)
        hm <- as.data.frame(hm)
        hm$PeakfinderSet <- "Cl_2"

        hm3 <- rbindlist(ENS_List_cl_3[lengths(ENS_List_cl_3) > 18], fill = TRUE)
        hm3 <- as.data.frame(hm3)
        hm3$PeakfinderSet <- "Cl_3"

        hm <- rbind(hm, hm3)

        hm_rev <- rbindlist(ENS_List_rev[lengths(ENS_List_rev) > 18], fill = TRUE)
        hm_rev$PeakfinderSet <- "Cl_2"

        hm_rev3 <- rbindlist(ENS_List_rev_cl_3[lengths(ENS_List_rev_cl_3) > 18], fill = TRUE)
        hm_rev3$PeakfinderSet <- "Cl_3"

        hm_rev <- rbind(hm_rev, hm_rev3, fill = TRUE)

        # Training labels for FDR estimation
        # score = 1 : real peak candidates
        # score = 0 : randomized peak candidates
        hm$score <- 1
        hm_rev$score <- 0

        hm_all <- rbind(hm, hm_rev)
        hm_all$ENS <- NULL
        hm_all$Height_SD <- NULL
        hm_all$Height_SD_all <- NULL
        hm_all$Fraction_SD <- NULL
        hm_all$Fraction_SD_all <- NULL
        hm_all$cluster2 <- NULL

        # Remove duplicated columns if present
        colnames(hm_all)[dupl <- duplicated(colnames(hm_all))]
        if(any(dupl)){
          hm_all <- data.frame(hm_all)[, -dupl]
        }

        hm_all <- as.data.table(hm_all)

        # Flatten nested list-columns to plain vectors
        hm_all_temp <- apply(hm_all, 2, function(x){
          x[lengths(x) == 0] <- NA
          xl <- unlist(x)
          if(length(x) != length(xl)){
            x <<- x
            stop()
          }
          xl
        })

        hm_all_temp <- data.frame(hm_all_temp)
        hm_all_temp$score <- as.numeric(hm_all_temp$score)

        # Keep the cl_2 training subset for FDR calibration
        hmsub <- hm_all_temp[hm_all_temp$PeakfinderSet == "Cl_2",]
        set.seed(1234)
        hmsub$score <- jitter(hmsub$score, amount = 0.001)

        hm$FDR_RF <- -1
        hm$FDR_DL <- -1

        IsoFrac_PeakResults <- hm
        IsoFrac_PeakResults_random <- hm_rev

        save(IsoFrac_PeakResults, IsoFrac_PeakResults_random, file = Isopath)

      }else{
        load(Isopath)
      }

      # Store peak tables in the input object
      input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable <- IsoFrac_PeakResults
      input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random <- IsoFrac_PeakResults_random

      # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Limit predicted fractions to the valid gel range before MW conversion
      # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
      input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$Fraction_lm[input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$Fraction_lm < -1] <- -1
      input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$Fraction_lm[input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$Fraction_lm > 29] <- 29

      input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$Fraction_BS_lo[input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$Fraction_BS_lo < -3] <- -3
      input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$Fraction_BS_hi[input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$Fraction_BS_hi > 31] <- 31

      input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$Fraction_lm[input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$Fraction_lm < -1] <- -1
      input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$Fraction_lm[input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$Fraction_lm > 29] <- 29

      input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$Fraction_BS_lo[input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$Fraction_BS_lo < -3] <- -3
      input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$Fraction_BS_hi[input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$Fraction_BS_hi > 31] <- 31

      # Load the gel-specific fraction-to-MW model trained in the compiler step
      if(!exists("Models")){
        load("../IsoFracCompiler/MW_Models_v3.rda")
        h2o.init(nthreads = 10)
      }

      Models.i <- Models[[which(input$xname == names(Models))]]
      FractionShift <- 0

      # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Convert fraction positions into estimated MWs for real peak candidates
      # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
      input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$MW_lm <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$Fraction_lm))
      input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$MW_lm_hi <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$Fraction_BS_hi))
      input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$MW_lm_lo <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$Fraction_BS_lo))

      input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$MW_lm_gel_hi <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor_addon$hi, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$Fraction_lm) + FractionShift)
      input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$MW_lm_gel_lo <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor_addon$lo, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$Fraction_lm) + FractionShift)

      input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$MW_fr <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$Fraction_lm) + FractionShift)
      input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$MW_fr_hi <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$Fraction_BS_hi) + FractionShift)
      input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$MW_fr_lo <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$Fraction_BS_lo) + FractionShift)

      input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$MW_fr_gel_hi <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor_addon$hi, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$Fraction_lm) + FractionShift)
      input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$MW_fr_gel_lo <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor_addon$lo, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable$Fraction_lm) + FractionShift)

      # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Convert fraction positions into estimated MWs for randomized controls
      # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
      input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$MW_lm <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$Fraction_lm))
      input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$MW_lm_hi <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$Fraction_BS_hi))
      input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$MW_lm_lo <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$Fraction_BS_lo))

      input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$MW_lm_gel_hi <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor_addon$hi, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$Fraction_lm) + FractionShift)
      input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$MW_lm_gel_lo <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor_addon$lo, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$Fraction_lm) + FractionShift)

      input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$MW_fr <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$Fraction_lm) + FractionShift)
      input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$MW_fr_hi <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$Fraction_BS_hi) + FractionShift)
      input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$MW_fr_lo <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$Fraction_BS_lo) + FractionShift)

      input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$MW_fr_gel_hi <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor_addon$hi, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$Fraction_lm) + FractionShift)
      input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$MW_fr_gel_lo <- predict(Models.i$MW_Predictor_addon$lo, unlist(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random$Fraction_lm) + FractionShift)

      # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
      # Build a peak-identity network:
      # nearby peaks in fraction / MW space are grouped and collapsed into
      # a single compressed MW variant (protein isoform candidate).
      # ----------------------------------------------------------------------
      cl <- makeCluster(2, outfile = "")
      print("Started Compilation of PeakIdentityList.")

      ipr_PeakIdentityList <- parLapply(
        cl,
        list(input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable, input$IsoFrac_PeakResultsTable_random),
        function(ipr){
          ipr <<- ipr

          library(data.table)
          ipr <- as.data.table(ipr)
          library(igraph)

          ipr_PeakIdentity <- ipr[,{
            cat("\r", .BY$ENS)

            temp <- .SD
            temp$id <- 1:dim(temp)[1]
            temp[,{
              temp2 <- .SD
            }, id]

            Lapi <- lapply(1:dim(temp)[1], function(it){
              i <- temp[it,]

              # Keep peak rows robust to empty Height fields
              if(lengths(i$Height)[1] == 0){
                i$Height <- list(-1)
              }

              check <- temp[-it,]
              lifu <- c(unlist(check$Fraction_lm) - unlist(i$Fraction_lm))

              # Connect only peaks that are close enough in MW / fraction space
              tempMix <- check[abs(lifu) < 1,]

              if(dim(tempMix)[1] > 0){
                re <- cbind(
                  unlist(i$Fraction_lm),
                  unlist(tempMix$Fraction_lm),
                  max(abs(lifu)[abs(lifu) < 10], na.rm = TRUE),
                  unlist(i$Height),
                  unlist(i$Peak),
                  unlist(i$Start),
                  unlist(i$End),
                  unlist(i$Fraction_lm),
                  unlist(i$Height_lm),
                  unlist(i$Fraction_BS_hi),
                  unlist(i$Fraction_BS_lo),
                  unlist(i$cluster2),
                  unlist(i$Fraction_sd_80)
                )
                re <- data.frame(re)
              }else{
                re <- cbind(
                  i$Fraction_lm,
                  i$Fraction_lm,
                  0,
                  unlist(i$Height),
                  unlist(i$Peak),
                  unlist(i$Start),
                  unlist(i$End),
                  unlist(i$Fraction_lm),
                  unlist(i$Height_lm),
                  unlist(i$Fraction_BS_hi),
                  unlist(i$Fraction_BS_lo),
                  unlist(i$cluster2),
                  unlist(i$Fraction_sd_80)
                )
                re <- data.frame(re)
              }

              re
            })

            Netfun <- rbindlist(Lapi)
            g <- graph_from_data_frame(d = Netfun)
            g <- as.undirected(g)

            # Collapse connected peaks into clique-like peak families
            MaxCliques <- maximal.cliques(g)
            le <- lapply(1:length(MaxCliques), function(x){
              data.table(as.numeric(attributes(MaxCliques[[x]])$names), x)
            })
            le <- rbindlist(le)
            colnames(le) <- c("Fraction", "PeakIdentity")

            Mapping <- le[, paste(PeakIdentity, collapse = "_"), Fraction]
            temp$Compressed_MW_Variants <- Mapping$V1[match(temp$Fraction_lm, Mapping$Fraction)]
            temp
          }, ENS]

          # Summarize each compressed MW variant by mean and SD
          ipr_PeakIdentity[, c("MW_lm_Compressed_", "MW_lm_Compressed_sd") := {
            temp <- .SD
            list(
              as.double(mean(unlist(temp$MW_lm), na.rm = TRUE)),
              as.double(sd(unlist(temp$MW_lm), na.rm = TRUE))
            )
          }, .(ENS, Compressed_MW_Variants)]

          ipr_PeakIdentity
        }
      )

      stopCluster(cl)

      input$IdentifiedPeaks_Table <- ipr_PeakIdentityList[[1]]
      input$IdentifiedPeaks_Table_random <- ipr_PeakIdentityList[[2]]

      print("Finished Compilation of PeakIdentityList.")
      save(input, file = rdapath)

    })

  }else{
    PeakFinder <- try({ load(rdapath) })
  }

  print(paste("Loaded PeakfinderData from", file.info(rdapath)$mtime))

  if(class(PeakFinder) == "try-error"){
    print("!!! WARNING !!!")
    print("Problems in PeakFinder")
    print(input$xname)
  }

  input
})



options(warn = 1)
```

## Isoform candidate summary across experiments

This section summarizes the number of detected IsoFrac protein isoform candidates per gene across the different gels/experiments. We first merge the final peak tables from all experiments and then count high-confidence candidates after filtering by peak FDR and peak width. The resulting gene-by-experiment matrix is shown as a heatmap to illustrate how often each gene yields one or more protein isoform candidates.

In a second step, we build a simple network representation in which nodes correspond to estimated molecular weights and experiments. This visualization helps show whether the same gene produces similar MW-resolved candidates across gels and whether candidate detection is reproducible between experiments.

Low-confidence or very broad peaks are excluded from these summaries to keep the visualization focused on the most reliable protein isoform candidates.

```{r Compilation of IdentifiedPeaks_Tables and Network}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Summarize detected protein isoform candidates across gels / experiments
# and visualize how many are found per gene and per experiment.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Sanity check: search specificity in the first dataset
table(TableListNormEnsHdbScanMW_Peaks[[1]]$InputTable$SearchSpecificity)

# Combine all peak tables and keep track of the originating gel

  xp <- x$IdentifiedPeaks_Table
  xp$gel <- x$xname
  xp
})

  x <<- x
  print(x$xname)

  IP <- x$IdentifiedPeaks_Table

  # Keep only high-confidence candidates
  IP <- IP[FDR_RF < 0.01,]
  IP <- IP[unlist(Fraction_width) < 2,]

  # Count unique compressed MW variants per gene
  IP <- IP[grep(";", ENS, invert = TRUE), {
    list(
      MWlog10 = unique(MW_lm_Compressed_),
      mpw = -10,
      maxFracWidth = max(unlist(Fraction_width), na.rm = TRUE),
      MW_lm_lo = median(MW_lm_lo),
      MW_lm_hi = median(MW_lm_lo)
    )
  }, ENS]

  IP$Experiment <- x$xname
  IP
})

    Temp <- IsoformCountTable[ENS == i]

    # Estimate MW for each candidate by using the MW range from the fit
    Temp$MW <- apply(Temp, 1, function(x){
      sel <- Temp$MWlog10[
        Temp$MWlog10 >= as.numeric(x[names(x) == "MW_lm_lo"]) &
        Temp$MWlog10 <= as.numeric(x[names(x) == "MW_lm_hi"])
      ]
      sel <- c(as.numeric(x[1]), sel)
      median(sel)
    })

    Temp$MW <- round(10^round(Temp$MW, 2), -3)

    g <- graph_from_data_frame(as.data.frame(Temp)[, c("MW", "Experiment")])

    vertices <- V(g)
    shape <- sapply(names(vertices), function(x){
      xu <- lapply(c("10per", "8per", "5per"), grep, x)
      fu <- which(xu > 0)
      if(length(fu) == 0) fu <- 0
      fu
    })

    col <- shape
    col[col == 0] <- "grey"
    V(g)$color <- col
    V(g)$border <- "transparent"
    V(g)$shape <- c("circle", "square")[(shape != 0) + 1]

    wi <- as.numeric(names(V(g)))
    wi[is.na(wi)] <- 100000
    V(g)$size <- wi / max(wi) * 30
    V(g)$bg <- "transparent"

    plot(
      g,
      main = paste(i, paste(substr(gn, 1, 20), "..."), sep = "\n"),
      vertex.frame.color = "transparent"
    )
  }

  dev.off()
  system("open ./Isofrac_MW_graphs.pdf")
}
```
